data.one_liner: Saves images and videos from network or temporary files to the device gallery.
data.what_it_does: Saves images and videos from local temporary paths or network URLs into the device's external storage so they appear in Android Gallery or iOS Photos. It handles platform-specific saving mechanisms and allows saving into custom folders or albums.
use_when: You need to save captured photos or recorded videos to the device gallery
You need to download and save media files from network URLs to Android Gallery or iOS Photos
avoid_when: You only need to pick images from the gallery without saving new ones
You are working on platforms other than Android and iOS
strengths: Supports both local temporary files and network URLs
Makes saved media immediately visible in Android Gallery and iOS Photos
Supports saving files into custom folders or albums
weaknesses: Requires manual native permission configuration for Android and iOS
Limited platform support (only Android and iOS)
data.setup_notes: Requires adding NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription to iOS Info.plist and android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permission for Android.

alternatives.name: image_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: If your primary goal is letting users pick images or videos from the device rather than saving them.
